info.name: E-Learning Manual Smoke
info.description:
Manual shadow/smoke workflow for the E-Learning backend portfolio API.

Known blockers and notes:
- No public admin registration/bootstrap endpoint exists in the REST API. Admin approval requests are included as optional/manual and require an out-of-band admin token.
- CreateCourse, CreateEnrollment, and CreateSubmission now return created IDs directly in the response body.
- /health/ready checks database readiness only; it does not verify RabbitMQ readiness.
- Prefer /api/v1 routes throughout this collection.
- GET /api/v1/instructors/{{instructorId}}/with-courses remains as optional draft-course visibility verification.
- For a stronger demo, the happy path adds a module, lesson, and assignment before submit-for-review.
